reasoning_summary: The director of 'Love, Honor And Oh-Baby!', Charles Lamont, died on September 12, 1993, while the director of 'I Cover The Underworld', R. G. Springsteen, died on December 9, 1989. Since R. G. Springsteen died earlier than Charles Lamont, the film with the director who died later is 'I Cover The Underworld'.
